versions.changelog:
Initial release of auto-talk-tts skill.

- Automatically converts every message to natural speech using edge-tts, running asynchronously in the background.
- Handles package installation and message wrapping autonomously for seamless, hands-free operation.
- Enhances accessibility and workflow efficiency by delivering spoken responses without delays.
- Easily configurable voice, speed, pitch, and volume via config.json.
- Provides both fully automatic operation and manual override with the auto-speak command.
